title: Bring Live Activities to Mac
description: Discover how to drive Live Activities from your Mac app. Explore how Live Activities appear in the menu bar and Dynamic Island. Learn how to define your data model, create compact and expanded views with SwiftUI, and drive interactive updates using App Intents.
